Versioned primitive branch exchange and scoped aliases

splitaligner_exchange.Rd

An additive development RDS interface retaining complete result, tree and provenance. Single fixed branch-length profile only. Coordinates are independent of B aliases and tree-local node numbers.

Usage

export_splitaligner_exchange(result, species_tree, tree_source, producer,
  label_scheme, payload, file = NULL, branch_margin = 2L)
validate_splitaligner_exchange(x)
read_splitaligner_exchange(file)
transpose_splitaligner_exchange(x)
annotate_splitaligner_exchange(x, gene_id, tree = x$tree$phylo)
splitaligner_label_registry()
splitaligner_exchange_schema()
new_splitaligner_label_migration(x, to_scheme, target_aliases, authority,
  allow_synthetic = FALSE)
migrate_splitaligner_labels(x, migration, allow_synthetic = FALSE)

Arguments

result

A single fixed-mode splitaligner_result.

species_tree, tree

Explicit complete phylo reference or display instance.

tree_source

Explicit named provenance list with kind and id; original source bytes are preserved.

producer

Declared source commit/tree/parent, dirty scope, file hashes and development provenance.

label_scheme, to_scheme

Registered list with id and version.

payload

Branch_length type, name, units, identity scale, origin and spec_id.

file

New output path or existing input RDS, as appropriate.

branch_margin

2 for gene by branch, explicitly 1 for branch by gene.

x

A checked exchange envelope.

gene_id

One exact gene key.

target_aliases

Target B aliases in coordinate order.

authority

Explicit synthetic or source-bound migration evidence.

allow_synthetic

Explicit opt-in for synthetic fixture migration.

migration

A migration bound to exact tree and ledgers.

Value

An envelope, schema, registry, migration, or edge annotation table as named by the function. Validation returns the input invisibly.

Details

Schema 0.1.0-development. Unknown mode, payload, alias scope or provenance and non-bijective root/edge representations are rejected. No rerooting, pruning or composite expansion is performed. Tree geometry is separate from gene values. See exchange_handoff/S1/API.md in the development checkout for the full profile. La Terra reader and plotting compatibility remain untested.
